tagline: Find the right research and turn it into a testable question.
introduction: A research companion for navigating Aalto's public work and planning a small, evidence-based exploration.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Aalto University? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Map a research question
capabilities.description: Break a question into concepts and a search path through official Aalto sources.
outputs: concept map and source search plan

capabilities.title: Design a small experiment
capabilities.description: Turn an early idea into a falsifiable, low-risk evaluation plan.

capabilities.title: Read a supplied paper critically
capabilities.description: Extract the claim, method, limitations and follow-up questions from supplied research.
inputs: paper excerpt or official publication link

starterPrompts: Help me find Aalto research relevant to speech interfaces for older adults, and separate findings from open questions.
Outline a small usability study for a voice interface, with a measurable hypothesis and consent considerations.
Review this Aalto paper excerpt: what was measured, what was not, and what should I test next?

sources.title: Aalto University
sources.summary: Official university research, education and service information.
